purpose: I run a small specialty food company and got offered a chance to place branded refrigerated snack kiosks inside three regional hospitals, but everything is moving fast and the property management group sent over vague terms verbally. I need an agreement covering kiosk locations, electricity use, refrigeration responsibility, access hours, badge/security rules, health inspections, insurance, stocking schedules, theft/vandalism risk, spoilage losses during outages, revenue share or rent options, payment timing, exclusivity for our products, signage rights, data ownership from smart kiosks, maintenance response times, who handles customer complaints, termination rights if sales are weak, expansion to more hospitals if it works, and what happens if ownership of the buildings changes. I also want it easy to review together, revise if needed, and sign digitally once finalized.
title: Agreement
